knowledge_description: Tensor memory layout differences, especially non-contiguous tensors and unusual strides, can expose hidden implementation bugs in deep learning framework operators.

input_generation: Generate tensors with non-contiguous memory layout
Generate tensors with unusual stride patterns

tensor_constraints: Do not restrict inputs to contiguous tensors only
Preserve valid tensor metadata while exploring layout variations
harness_guidance.api_invocation: Call target API with both contiguous and non-contiguous tensors

expected_failures: Unexpected behavior compared with contiguous tensor reference
